newsitem.title: UK: Invesco makes cash call to raise 119 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Invesco makes cash call to raise 119 mln stg.

text.p: Britain's Invesco Plc said on Monday that it is setting a 1-for-5 rights issue at 220p per unit to raise around 119 million stg.

Invesco said in a statement that cash raised via the rights issue would be used to pay in part for its merger with mutual fund company AIM Management Group Inc. Invesco and Houston-based AIM announced on November 4 that they would create one of the world's largest investment management businesses in a deal valued at $1.6 billion.
The combined group will be called Amvesco Plc.
Invesco said on November 4 that the merger would be paid for with about $1.1 billion in new stock and the rest in cash and debt.

The rights issue will be made by Invesco Funding LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Invesco, on the basis of one unit of convertible unsecured loan stock in Invesco Funding for every five existing Invesco ordinary shares.
